question: Show the name and email of every employee in the Finance department.
query: SELECT name, email FROM employees WHERE department = 'Finance';

question: How many employees work remotely?
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE is_remote = 1;

question: What is the highest salary in the company?
query: SELECT MAX(salary) FROM employees;

question: List the names of employees hired after 2021-01-01, newest hire first.
query: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE hire_date > '2021-01-01' ORDER BY hire_date DESC;

question: Show the name and budget of every department located in Boston.
query: SELECT name, budget FROM departments WHERE location = 'Boston';

question: How many sales were made in the West region?
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales WHERE region = 'West';

question: What is the total sales amount in each region? Show the region and the total.
query: SELECT region, SUM(amount) FROM sales GROUP BY region;

question: Which departments have more than one employee? Show the department and the number of employees.
query: SELECT department, COUNT(*) FROM employees GROUP BY department HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

question: List the names of employees who have taken sick leave.
query: SELECT DISTINCT e.name FROM employees e JOIN leaves l ON l.employee_id = e.id WHERE l.leave_type = 'Sick';

question: Show each project's name together with the name of the department that owns it.
query: SELECT p.name, d.name FROM projects p JOIN departments d ON p.department_id = d.id;

question: What is the combined budget of all projects that are not completed?
query: SELECT SUM(budget) FROM projects WHERE status <> 'Completed';

question: Show the three highest paid employees with their salaries.
query: SELECT name, salary FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 3;

question: How many hours are allocated to each project in total? Show the project name and the total hours.
query: SELECT p.name, SUM(ep.hours_allocated) FROM employee_projects ep JOIN projects p ON ep.project_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name;

question: How many leave requests are of type Annual?
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leaves WHERE leave_type = 'Annual';

question: Which employees earn more than the company-wide average salary? Show name and salary.
query: SELECT name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees);

question: What is the name of the employee with the largest total sales amount?
query: SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN sales s ON s.employee_id = e.id GROUP BY e.id, e.name ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which projects have more than one employee assigned? Show the project name and the number of assigned employees.
query: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) FROM employee_projects ep JOIN projects p ON p.id = ep.project_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

question: Which departments have no active projects? Show the department names.
query: SELECT name FROM departments WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT department_id FROM projects WHERE status = 'Active');

question: For each department, who is the highest paid employee? Show department, name and salary.
query: SELECT e.department, e.name, e.salary FROM employees e WHERE e.salary = (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM employees WHERE department = e.department);

question: Which product lines have total sales above 3000? Show the product line and its total sales.
query: SELECT product_line, SUM(amount) FROM sales GROUP BY product_line HAVING SUM(amount) > 3000;

question: Show the names of all customers from Germany.
query: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE country = 'Germany';

question: How many products cost more than 100?
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE price > 100;

question: What is the lowest product price?
query: SELECT MIN(price) FROM products;

question: List the name and brand of every product with fewer than 50 items in stock.
query: SELECT name, brand FROM products WHERE stock_quantity < 50;

question: How many orders were cancelled?
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'Cancelled';

question: Show the names of customers who signed up in 2022, earliest signup first.
query: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_date < '2023-01-01' ORDER BY signup_date;

question: How many customers are there in each loyalty tier? Show the tier and the count.
query: SELECT loyalty_tier, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY loyalty_tier;

question: What is the average product price for each brand? Show the brand and the average price.
query: SELECT brand, AVG(price) FROM products GROUP BY brand;

question: Show each product name together with the name of its category.
query: SELECT p.name, c.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id;

question: What is the total quantity sold of each product? Show the product name and the total quantity.
query: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name;

question: Show the id, date and total amount of the five most recent orders.
query: SELECT id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 5;

question: How many reviews has each product received? Show the product name and the review count.
query: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name;

question: What is the total order amount per customer country? Show the country and the total.
query: SELECT c.country, SUM(o.total_amount) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country;

question: How many distinct customers have written at least one review?
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM reviews;

question: Which products have never been reviewed? Show their names.
query: SELECT name FROM products WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM reviews);

question: Which customers placed an order worth more than the average order total? Show each distinct customer name.
query: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.total_amount > (SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM orders);

question: Which customer has spent the most across all of their orders? Show the customer name.
query: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which customers bought products from more than one category? Show the customer name.
query: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) > 1;

question: Show the customers whose total_spent is above the average total_spent of Gold tier customers. Show name and total_spent.
query: SELECT name, total_spent FROM customers WHERE total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM customers WHERE loyalty_tier = 'Gold');

question: Which category contains the most products? Show the category name.
query: SELECT c.name FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List the names of all fourth-year students.
query: SELECT name FROM students WHERE year = 4;

question: How many courses are worth at least 4 credits?
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM courses WHERE credits >= 4;

question: What is the highest GPA among all students?
query: SELECT MAX(gpa) FROM students;

question: List the titles of all courses, those with the most credits first, then alphabetically.
query: SELECT title FROM courses ORDER BY credits DESC, title;

question: Show the name and office of every instructor whose title is Professor.
query: SELECT name, office FROM instructors WHERE title = 'Professor';

question: How many students are majoring in Physics?
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE major = 'Physics';

question: How many students are in each year of study? Show the year and the count.
query: SELECT year, COUNT(*) FROM students GROUP BY year;

question: What is the total scholarship amount awarded in each year? Show the year and the total.
query: SELECT awarded_year, SUM(amount) FROM scholarships GROUP BY awarded_year;

question: Show each instructor's name together with the name of their department.
query: SELECT i.name, d.name FROM instructors i JOIN departments d ON i.department_id = d.id;

question: What is the average attendance percentage in each course? Show the course title and the average.
query: SELECT c.title, AVG(e.attendance_pct) FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id GROUP BY c.id, c.title;

question: List the distinct names of students who were enrolled in a course during Fall 2023.
query: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.id WHERE e.semester = 'Fall 2023';

question: Show the code and title of courses whose maximum enrollment is greater than 30.
query: SELECT code, title FROM courses WHERE max_enrollment > 30;

question: How many times has each grade been awarded? Show the grade and the count.
query: SELECT grade, COUNT(*) FROM enrollments GROUP BY grade;

question: Show the name and GPA of the two students with the highest GPA.
query: SELECT name, gpa FROM students ORDER BY gpa DESC LIMIT 2;

question: Which students have a GPA above the average GPA of all students? Show name and GPA.
query: SELECT name, gpa FROM students WHERE gpa > (SELECT AVG(gpa) FROM students);

question: Which students are enrolled in more than two courses? Show the name and the number of enrollments.
query: SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;

question: Show the names of students who have never received a scholarship.
query: SELECT name FROM students WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM scholarships);

question: Which courses have more than two enrollments? Show the course title and the number of enrollments.
query: SELECT c.title, COUNT(*) FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id GROUP BY c.id, c.title HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;

question: What is the average GPA of students who hold at least one scholarship?
query: SELECT AVG(gpa) FROM students WHERE id IN (SELECT student_id FROM scholarships);

question: Which student has received the largest total scholarship amount? Show the student name.
query: SELECT s.name FROM students s JOIN scholarships sc ON sc.student_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY SUM(sc.amount) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show the names of all doctors with more than 15 years of experience.
query: SELECT name FROM doctors WHERE years_experience > 15;

question: How many hospitals are located in the state of IL?
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hospitals WHERE state = 'IL';

question: What is the largest bed count of any hospital?
query: SELECT MAX(bed_count) FROM hospitals;

question: List the names of all female patients.
query: SELECT name FROM patients WHERE gender = 'Female';

question: How many appointments were cancelled?
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE status = 'Cancelled';

question: Show the name and consultation fee of every neurologist, cheapest first.
query: SELECT name, consultation_fee FROM doctors WHERE specialization = 'Neurology' ORDER BY consultation_fee;

question: How many doctors are there in each specialization? Show the specialization and the count.
query: SELECT specialization, COUNT(*) FROM doctors GROUP BY specialization;

question: What is the average consultation fee for each specialization? Show the specialization and the average.
query: SELECT specialization, AVG(consultation_fee) FROM doctors GROUP BY specialization;

question: What is the total billed amount in each ward? Show the ward and the total.
query: SELECT ward, SUM(total_bill) FROM admissions GROUP BY ward;

question: Show each admission's diagnosis together with the name of the admitted patient.
query: SELECT a.diagnosis, p.name FROM admissions a JOIN patients p ON p.id = a.patient_id;

question: Show each hospital's name together with the number of departments it has.
query: SELECT h.name, COUNT(*) FROM hospitals h JOIN departments d ON d.hospital_id = h.id GROUP BY h.id, h.name;

question: Which doctors have more than two appointments? Show the doctor name and the number of appointments.
query: SELECT d.name, COUNT(*) FROM doctors d JOIN appointments a ON a.doctor_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id, d.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;

question: What is the average length of stay in days across admissions that have a discharge date?
query: SELECT AVG(julianday(discharge_date) - julianday(admit_date)) FROM admissions WHERE discharge_date IS NOT NULL;

question: Show the patient name and total bill for the three most expensive admissions.
query: SELECT p.name, a.total_bill FROM admissions a JOIN patients p ON p.id = a.patient_id ORDER BY a.total_bill DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Which doctors have handled more than one admission? Show the doctor name and the number of admissions.
query: SELECT d.name, COUNT(*) FROM doctors d JOIN admissions a ON a.doctor_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id, d.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

question: Which doctors have no appointments at all? Show their names.
query: SELECT name FROM doctors WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT doctor_id FROM appointments);

question: Which hospital has the highest total billing across its admissions? Show the hospital name.
query: SELECT h.name FROM hospitals h JOIN admissions a ON a.hospital_id = h.id GROUP BY h.id, h.name ORDER BY SUM(a.total_bill) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show the names of patients whose admission bill was above the average admission bill. List each name once.
query: SELECT DISTINCT p.name FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON a.patient_id = p.id WHERE a.total_bill > (SELECT AVG(total_bill) FROM admissions);

question: For each doctor with admissions, show the doctor name and the total billed across their admissions.
query: SELECT d.name, SUM(a.total_bill) FROM doctors d JOIN admissions a ON a.doctor_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id, d.name;

question: Which patients have a prescription lasting more than 30 days? Show each patient name once.
query: SELECT DISTINCT p.name FROM patients p JOIN appointments a ON a.patient_id = p.id JOIN prescriptions rx ON rx.appointment_id = a.id WHERE rx.duration_days > 30;
